record.body: Move .canon out of the code repo into its own private git repo for handoff sync between machines. Keep file records as the source of truth. All worktrees share one store directory. Each machine builds its own SQLite index. Open: location and discovery of the store, pull at session start and push at session end, store validation in the store repo, migration of existing records. Handoff only: one writer at a time.
record.subject: external-store-repo
